scope: Twenty prioritized retouching capabilities across five selected professional reference products. This is a documented feature study and AURA target specification, not an independent product ranking or implementation-completion report.

products.name: Adobe Photoshop
products.focus: Manual healing, cloning, tonal brushes and compositing.
products.note: Manual tools are not evidence of automatic face-aware processing.

products.name: Affinity
products.focus: Editable frequency separation and precision texture work.
products.note: Current Affinity Pixel studio documentation; not limited to the older Photo 2 edition.

products.name: Retouch4me
products.focus: Specialist automated portrait and studio cleanup plugins.
products.note: A suite of separate tools; access depends on the plugins and workflow purchased.

products.name: Evoto
products.focus: Automated skin, complexion and portrait adjustments.
products.note: The manual documents high/low-frequency sliders; this does not establish a general layer-stack editor.

products.name: PortraitPro
products.focus: Portrait-specific skin, eyes, makeup and lighting controls.
products.note: Automatic batch processing is documented for Studio Max; Photoshop Smart Filter integration for Studio and Studio Max.

features.name: Blemish and acne removal
features.evidence: Heal / blemish removal / Healing Brush.
features.target: Remove temporary spots using nearby texture, with editable target and donor regions.
features.gap: Detector and donor-patch renderer exist; editor controls and real-photo quality still need verification.
features.controls: Sensitivity, size, strength, protect mark, brush override.
features.acceptance: No spill outside the mask; reject poor donors and keep original pixels recoverable.

features.name: Precision healing and clone brush
features.evidence: Healing Brush / Clone Stamp; Affinity high-band cloning.
features.target: Provide user-selected sampling, source previews and repeatable strokes.
features.gap: Automatic donor healing is not an interactive clone/heal brush.
features.controls: Heal or clone, source point, radius, hardness, flow, aligned sampling.
features.acceptance: Source coordinates remain correct after zoom/crop/rotation; undo and export reproduce the strokes.

features.name: Editable frequency separation
features.evidence: Affinity editable bands; Retouch4me two/three-band Photoshop output; Evoto frequency sliders.
features.target: Expose tone and texture independently through a reversible frequency operation.
features.gap: Band decomposition exists; editable frequency-layer authoring has not been established.
features.controls: Radius, low/high amount, band preview, per-band mask; optional mid band later.
features.acceptance: Neutral settings reconstruct the original within float tolerance; preview and full-size export use equivalent physical radii.

features.name: Micro dodge and burn
features.evidence: Dodge/Burn brushes; Evoto Even with Dodge & Burn.
features.target: Even small luminance variations while retaining the skin's fine detail.
features.gap: Evening logic exists; a dedicated manual/automatic Retouch workflow is not verified.
features.controls: Auto amount, dodge/burn brush, flow, luminance range, mask.
features.acceptance: Measure texture and hue drift; prevent highlight clipping and dark halos.

features.name: Macro dodge and burn / portrait relighting
features.evidence: Sculpt with Dodge & Burn / Portrait Volumes / Image Relighting.
features.target: Refine broad facial illumination with separate controls from micro evening.
features.gap: Face zones and light-direction analysis exist; editor integration requires work.
features.controls: Contour intensity, highlight/shadow amounts, lighting preview, local override.
features.acceptance: No geometric movement; stable results across a person's frames without flattened facial structure.

features.name: Selective skin color correction
features.evidence: Skin tone controls; low-frequency color work.
features.target: Correct local casts and redness while keeping skin luminance and texture separately controllable.
features.gap: Tone evening and global white balance are starting points, not complete skin-specific color controls.
features.controls: Temperature, tint, hue/chroma, redness, luminance lock, sampled reference.
features.acceptance: Skin-mask boundaries blend cleanly; hair, lips and background retain their intended colors.

features.name: Face-to-body complexion matching
features.evidence: Unify Body Complexion and separate face/body complexion tools.
features.target: Match face, neck and body color under inconsistent lighting.
features.gap: No complete face-to-body reference-matching workflow was established in the inspected surface.
features.controls: Reference region, affected regions, color amount, luminance amount.
features.acceptance: Respect different illumination; compare measured color changes inside and outside chosen skin regions.

features.name: Texture-preserving skin smoothing
features.evidence: Textured Smoothing / ClearSkin.
features.target: Smooth uneven tone with independently constrained texture changes.
features.gap: Texture guard and tone-evening engine exist; real-portrait acceptance remains necessary.
features.controls: Smoothing, texture retention, pore preview, protected regions.
features.acceptance: Check actual rendered texture plus visual realism at 100%; band-energy alone does not prove pore fidelity.

features.name: Shine and oily-highlight reduction
features.evidence: Mattifier.
features.target: Reduce distracting specular shine without flattening all highlights.
features.gap: Shine-reduce operation exists; selective control and real-photo behavior need verification.
features.controls: Amount, highlight threshold, feathering, brush refinement.
features.acceptance: Retain intended catchlights and luminous highlights; no gray patches.

features.name: Under-eye shadow and bag correction
features.evidence: Dark-circle / Dodge & Burn retouching.
features.target: Lighten local under-eye shadows while preserving lower-eyelid texture and depth.
features.gap: Under-eye analysis and renderer exist; manual bounds and review controls need integration.
features.controls: Left/right strength, shadow lift, area refinement.
features.acceptance: Keep eyelid edges intact and avoid a bright strip across the cheek.

features.name: Wrinkle and fine-line softening
features.evidence: Wrinkle retouching and independent tone/texture repair.
features.target: Offer selective reduction of distracting lines with an adjustable retained amount.
features.gap: Generic smoothing is not a dedicated wrinkle-selection workflow.
features.controls: Region brush, reduction amount, texture retention.
features.acceptance: Retain expression and avoid erasing all facial lines; verify at original resolution.

features.name: Eye redness and vessel cleanup
features.evidence: Eye Vessels; eye cleaning and red-eye correction.
features.target: Separate sclera cleanup from flash red-eye correction.
features.gap: Sclera/iris analysis exists; pupil red-eye handling and dedicated controls remain to verify.
features.controls: Redness, sclera amount, red-eye target, per-eye mask.
features.acceptance: Do not bleach the sclera or spill into eyelids and iris.

features.name: Iris, lash and catchlight refinement
features.evidence: Eye Enhancement / Eye Brilliance.
features.target: Add controlled existing-eye detail and catchlight adjustment.
features.gap: Iris and catchlight guards provide a starting point, not the complete tool.
features.controls: Iris detail, lash contrast, existing-catchlight intensity, left/right controls.
features.acceptance: No invented iris detail in default enhancement; catchlight geometry remains stable.

features.name: Natural teeth whitening
features.evidence: White Teeth.
features.target: Reduce distracting tooth color casts with bounded local luminance changes.
features.gap: Tooth-locus corrections exist; selection and individual controls need integration.
features.controls: Warmth reduction, brightness, strength, tooth mask.
features.acceptance: Preserve tooth shading and gum/lip colors; avoid clipped white teeth.

features.name: Glasses reflection reduction
features.evidence: Reduce Reflections in Glasses.
features.target: Reduce recoverable glare; allow aligned reference-frame repair when valid.
features.gap: Glare and sibling-frame borrowing modules exist; broad single-image glare recovery is not established.
features.controls: Glare mask, reduction, optional reference, alignment preview.
features.acceptance: Do not claim to recover fully obscured detail without evidence; compare edges and alignment.

features.name: Stray hair and flyaway cleanup
features.evidence: Stray Hairs; sampled high-frequency texture repair.
features.target: Clean selected flyaways while retaining the hairline and intentional strands.
features.gap: Measured stray-hair analysis exists; difficult backgrounds and editor brush control need validation.
features.controls: Sensitivity, thickness, keep/remove brush, donor preview.
features.acceptance: Protect hairline and foreground strands; no repeated background patterns.

features.name: Lip and digital makeup refinement
features.evidence: Digital Makeup.
features.target: Apply user-chosen lip, cheek and eye color through editable feature masks.
features.gap: No complete makeup workflow was found in the inspected Retouch surface.
features.controls: Lip color/opacity, blush, eye makeup, per-region masks.
features.acceptance: Creative controls remain separately chosen; masks track features and preserve texture.

features.name: Clothing lint and wrinkle cleanup
features.evidence: Fabric / Dust.
features.target: Separate small lint repairs from broad fabric-fold smoothing.
features.gap: Clothing-issue analysis exists; broad fabric wrinkle removal is not proven.
features.controls: Lint sensitivity, fold amount, garment mask, manual repair.
features.acceptance: Preserve seams, logos and fabric weave without stretched textures.

features.name: Studio backdrop cleanup
features.evidence: Clean Backdrop; manual cloning.
features.target: Remove backdrop spots and small folds with subject-aware repair.
features.gap: Garment cleanup does not establish backdrop cleanup; needs its own region workflow.
features.controls: Backdrop mask, dust size, fold amount, edge protection.
features.acceptance: Keep hair and subject edges; avoid flattening intended background gradients.

features.name: Batch retouching with individual overrides
features.evidence: PortraitPro Studio Max batch mode; Evoto batch adjustments.
features.target: Apply a selected retouch preset across photos with per-photo and per-person review.
features.gap: Project passes and per-identity strength contracts exist; the full editor workflow and mask recalculation need validation.
features.controls: Preset, selected photos, per-person strength, review queue, cancel/resume.
features.acceptance: Recompute image-specific masks and donors; never copy raw pixel coordinates across photographs.
